text:
Bremen’s median asking rent stands at 11.38 €/m², up 2.6 % year‑on‑year and 25.5 % over the past five years, placing the city 19th of 37 German markets. The rent premium over existing contracts is 47 %, while a typical 60 m² unit costs about 683 €/month.

The market remains balanced with a vacancy rate of 2 % and an average of 26  days on market; 29 % of listings are let within a week. Affordability is moderate, as rent‑burden for two residents is 15.2 % and the asking‑rent spread (P25 9.65 €/m² – P75 13.24 €/m²) reflects limited tightness.

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent at 12.09 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 11.73 and 12.47 €/m², a 6.3 % increase.
